notes: Pure-play space infrastructure rollup (Made In Space, Adcole, Roccor, DPSS/DSS/LoadPath/Oakman/Techshot). 10-K names a handful of programs (Tranche 0 SDA Link 16 antennas, Lunar Gateway PPE ROSA, Artemis/Orion, Solar Cruiser solar sail, Archinaut/OSAM-2, AFRL via LoadPath). Customer concentration text emphasizes 'civil, commercial, national security'; no specific PE numbers disclosed.

claims.claim_text: Redwire designed and built deployable Link 16 antennas for Tranche 0 of the Space Development Agency's proliferated LEO satellite constellation, which is expected to deploy over 1,000 satellites over the next decade.
claims.subject: Redwire (via Roccor/LoadPath deployable antenna heritage)
claims.object_value: SDA Tranche 0 Transport Layer (proliferated LEO constellation, 1,000+ sats over decade)
claims.source_quote: Designed and built deployable Link 16 antennas for Tranche 0 of the Space Development Agency's proliferated LEO satellite constellation, which is expected to deploy over 1,000 satellites over the next decade, ensuring constant world-wide global coverage.

claims.claim_text: Redwire's ROSA solar arrays are being delivered for the Power and Propulsion Element of the NASA Lunar Gateway, and are positioned for future Department of Defense satellite projects.
claims.subject: Redwire (DPSS subsidiary)
claims.object_value: Lunar Gateway PPE + 'future commercial and DoD satellite projects'
claims.source_quote: Other ROSA systems are being developed or delivered for the OVZON-3 telecommunications satellite, the Power and Propulsion Element for the NASA Lunar Gateway, and other programs. ... future commercial and Department of Defense satellite projects.

claims.claim_text: Redwire has 'a long history of strong relationships and contracts with the Air Force Research Lab at Kirtland Air Force base in Albuquerque, New Mexico' via the LoadPath acquisition; this AFRL relationship is described as 'a key entry point to this critical location and customer.'
claims.subject: Redwire LoadPath subsidiary
claims.source_quote: LoadPath brought to Redwire a long history of strong relationships and contracts with the Air Force Research Lab at Kirkland Air Force base in Albuquerque, New Mexico. They were a key entry point to this critical location and customer.

claims.claim_text: Redwire participates in the National Defense Space Architecture (NDSA) and U.S. Space Force buildout via its SDA&R (Space Domain Awareness & Resiliency) portfolio of optical instruments, sensors, robotics, and full satellite solutions leveraging OSAM.
claims.subject: Redwire SDA&R portfolio
claims.object_value: National Defense Space Architecture (NDSA) / U.S. Space Force resiliency mission
claims.source_quote: significant space-based military infrastructure investment such as the National Defense Space Architecture (NDSA) and the creation of the U.S. Space Force... Our key offerings in this area include sensor systems for on-orbit monitoring, advanced modeling & simulation, cyber resiliency, asset hardening, robotics, and full satellite solutions leveraging our OSAM capabilities.

claims.claim_text: Redwire is a Roccor-heritage supplier of solar-sail and deployable structures for NASA's upcoming Solar Cruiser mission, and the Roccor acquisition is positioned as a 'solid foundation in the National Security space markets.'
claims.subject: Redwire Roccor subsidiary
claims.object_value: Solar Cruiser deployable solar sail + National Security space deployables
claims.source_quote: Roccor contributed to Redwire a solid foundation in the National Security space markets and one-of-a-kind deployable programs such as providing the solar sail for NASA's upcoming Solar Cruiser mission.

claims.claim_text: Redwire completed a large-scale 3D printing test for the approximately $73.8 million Archinaut One satellite mission (also known as OSAM-2) under contract with NASA.
claims.subject: Redwire Made-In-Space subsidiary
claims.source_quote: Completed a large-scale 3D printing test for the approximately $73.8 million Archinaut One satellite mission, also known as OSAM-2.

claims.claim_text: Redwire delivered the first two of five contracted navigational and inspection cameras for the Orion Spacecraft production line on NASA's Artemis program, and is on the Firefly Blue Ghost Lunar Lander providing avionics and Terrain Relative Navigation.
claims.subject: Redwire (Adcole/DSS heritage)
claims.object_value: Artemis / Orion / Firefly Blue Ghost CLPS
claims.source_quote: Delivered the first two of five contracted navigational and inspection cameras for the Orion Spacecraft production line on NASA's Artemis program... Awarded Firefly Blue Ghost Lunar Lander contract to provide avionics and critical Terrain Relative Navigation systems for NASA's Artemis program.

claims.claim_text: Redwire participates as an original prime contractor awardee on NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) contract.
claims.subject: Redwire (DSS subsidiary)
claims.source_quote: They are an original prime contractor awardee on NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services (CLPS) contract and continue as part of Redwire to provide mission critical sensors and services to notable spacecrafts such as Orion and Dream Chaser.

claims.claim_text: Redwire's patented suite of in-space manufacturing and robotic assembly (OSAM) is described as revolutionizing the ~$23 billion satellite manufacturing market and is protected by 'numerous patents.'
claims.subject: Redwire OSAM IP portfolio
claims.source_quote: patented suite of in-space manufacturing and robotic assembly technologies (referred to herein as on-orbit servicing, assembly and manufacturing, or OSAM), which is revolutionizing the approximately $23 billion satellite manufacturing market... Our OSAM solution has been proven in operation on the ISS since 2014 and is protected by our numerous patents.
